sourceHolds.reason: Pinned Fedora 45 kernel 7.2.9-300 lacks the reviewed October XFS/AMD fixes. Missing scanner matches do not establish source-fix coverage. The fixed 301 build has not reached an approved stable tag in retained official evidence.
sourceHolds.unblockEvidence: Approved same-stream stable kernel containing the reviewed fixes, or separately explicit reviewed testing approval; authenticate exact Fedora payloads and validate transaction, module preservation, initramfs and boot qualification before reviewing removal of this hold.
